50.13.text: Nor does your cruelty, however exquisite, avail you; it is rather a temptation to us. The oftener we are mown down by you, the more in number we grow; the blood of Christians is seed.
50.13.notes: ANF 3 (S. Thelwall). Latin (not verified this session): semen est sanguis Christianorum. "The blood of the martyrs is the seed of the Church" is the traditional paraphrase, not his words.
